units.source_text: 到了五月里，二女公子觉得身体异常，生起病来。

en.t: When May came, the Second Princess felt something wrong with her body and fell ill.

units.source_text: 并无特别苦痛，只是饮食比往常少进，终日躺卧。

en.t: She was not in any particular pain, but she ate less than usual and lay down all day.

units.source_text: 匂亲王还不曾见过这种样子，不甚了解，以为只是天气炎热之故。

en.t: Prince Niou had never seen her like this before and did not understand it well, thinking it was only because of the hot weather.

units.source_text: 但毕竟觉得有些奇怪，有时也问她：“你究竟怎么样了？照这病状看来，是怀孕呢。”

en.t: Still, he felt that something was odd, and sometimes asked her, "What is really the matter with you? Judging from these symptoms, it looks like pregnancy."

units.source_text: 二女公子甚觉羞耻，只是装作没事。

en.t: The Second Princess felt deeply ashamed and merely pretended that nothing was wrong.

units.source_text: 也没有多嘴的侍女从旁转达，故匂亲王无从确悉。

en.t: Nor was there any talkative maid at her side to tell him, so Prince Niou had no way to know for certain.

units.source_text: 到了八月里，二女公子从别人那里听到了匂亲王与六女公子结婚的日期。

en.t: When August came, the Second Princess heard from someone else the date set for Prince Niou's marriage to the Sixth Princess.

units.source_text: 匂亲王并不想瞒过二女公子，只因说出来很没趣，又对不起她，所以不告诉她。

en.t: Prince Niou had not meant to hide it from the Second Princess, but speaking of it would be awkward and would wrong her, so he did not tell her.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得如此秘密反而可恨。

en.t: The Second Princess felt that being kept in such secrecy made it all the more hateful.

units.source_text: 这结婚又不是偷偷地举行的，世间一般人都知道了，却连日子也不告诉她，叫她怎不怨恨呢？

en.t: The marriage was not being held in secret, and people everywhere already knew of it; since he would not even tell her the date, how could she help resenting him?

units.source_text: 自从二女公子迁居二条院之后，除了特殊情由之外，匂亲王即使入宫，晚上也不在宫中值宿。

en.t: Ever since the Second Princess had moved to the Nijo estate, except for special circumstances, Prince Niou did not spend the night on duty at the palace even when he entered court.

units.source_text: 其他各处也从来不去宿夜。

en.t: Nor had he ever gone to spend the night anywhere else.

units.source_text: 今后忽然外宿，叫二女公子何以为情呢？

en.t: If he suddenly began staying away at night from now on, what was the Second Princess supposed to feel?

units.source_text: 为欲缓和这种苦痛，他这时候常常到宫中值宿，预先使二女公子习惯独宿。

en.t: Wanting to soften that pain, he often went to spend the night on duty at the palace during this time, trying in advance to accustom the Second Princess to sleeping alone.

units.source_text: 但二女公子只觉得他冷酷无情，不胜怨恨。

en.t: But the Second Princess only felt that he was cold and heartless, and her resentment was more than she could bear.
